name: source_core_recovery

import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,base64
p=Path.cwd();w=p/'write_lane.py'
for n in ['r2-REVIEW.md','r2-GAP.md']:
 print('FILE',n);print((p/'inputs'/n).read_text())
s=(p/'inputs/tensor.txt').read_text().split('\f');print('ORIGINAL PAGE6',s[5]);print('SUMI 3.3 CONTEXT')
t=(p/'inputs/predelivery-sumi-v3.txt').read_text();i=t.index('Theorem 3.3');print(t[i-1200:i+3000]);print('PAGE',t[:i].count('\f')+1)
r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f','6','-l','6','-scale-to','1500','-singlefile','-png',str(p/'inputs/tensor.pdf')],capture_output=True,timeout=40);print('RENDER',r.returncode,r.stderr.decode());assert r.returncode==0
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(w),'rendered/original-p6.png','--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode(),text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert z.returncode==0
